title: SYS1 - HSM
description: DFSMShsm on SYS1: data from HSM_monitoring/loader (MF.HSM.EVENT, MF.HSM.QUERY, MF.HSM.DURATION, MF.HSM.TASK_CHECK). Generated by loader/tools/build-dashboards.ts.

list.name: host_id
list.label: HSM host
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WITH KEY = "host_id" WHERE "sysname" = '$sysname'
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WITH KEY = "host_id" WHERE "sysname" = '$sysname'

panels.title: Events
panels.description: All ARC* messages stored in InfluxDB (field events)

targets.query: SELECT sum("events") FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WHERE "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Errors (ARCnnnnE)
panels.description: Messages with severity E (last character of the message ID)

targets.query: SELECT sum("events") FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WHERE "msg_id" =~ /E$/ AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Interrupted functions
panels.description: ARC0570I, ARC0682I, ARC0625I, ARC1818I, ARC1837I and PSM / SSM "ENDED PRIOR TO COMPLETION"

targets.query: SELECT sum("events") FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WHERE ("msg_id" =~ /^ARC(0570|0682|0625|1818|1837)I$/ OR "status" = 'ENDED PRIOR TO COMPLETION') AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Critical (HSM functions HELD)
panels.description: ARC0744E (CDS backup failed - functions HELD), ARC0026E (journaling disabled), ARC1819I (FlashCopy relationship left on devices)

targets.query: SELECT sum("events") FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WHERE "msg_id" =~ /^ARC(0744E|0026E|1819I)$/ AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Data sets backed up
panels.description: Sum of DATA SETS BACKED UP from ARC0723I

targets.query: SELECT sum("ds_backed_up") FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC0723I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Space freed (space management)
panels.description: TRACK(S) FREED from ARC0523I converted to bytes (56,664 bytes per 3390 track)

targets.query: SELECT sum("freed_bytes") FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC0523I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.title: ERROR - no end in 2nd extract
panels.description: expectedEnd check: task still without an end message in the next extract (MF.HSM.TASK_CHECK level=ERROR) in the selected time range

targets.query: SELECT count("level_num") FROM "MF.HSM.TASK_CHECK" WHERE "level" = 'ERROR' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.title: WARNING - no end in extract
panels.description: First extract after the expectedEnd deadline without an end message (level=WARNING) in the selected time range

targets.query: SELECT count("level_num") FROM "MF.HSM.TASK_CHECK" WHERE "level" = 'WARNING' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Task completion check - latest
panels.description: Result of the expectedEnd check for every extract: deadline, state, level. "end vs deadline" = end time relative to the deadline (negative = before), "running for" = how long the task had been running at extract time.

targets.query: SELECT "task", "host_id", "deadline", "state", "level", "late_s", "running_s" FROM "MF.HSM.TASK_CHECK" WHERE "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Events by message
panels.description: Number of messages per time interval

targets.query: SELECT sum("events") FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WHERE "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "msg_id" fill(none)

panels.title: Average duration: last 7 days vs previous 7
panels.description: Average duration of successful runs of whole tasks. Fixed windows counted from now - independent of the dashboard time range. Red = 25% longer or more, green = shorter.

targets.query: SELECT mean("duration") AS "last 7 d" FROM "MF.HSM.DURATION" WHERE "status" !~ /^(TERMINATED|FAILED|UNSUCCESSFUL|ENDED PRIOR TO COMPLETION)$/ AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND time > now() - 7d GROUP BY "task"

SELECT mean("duration") AS "previous 7 d" FROM "MF.HSM.DURATION" WHERE "status" !~ /^(TERMINATED|FAILED|UNSUCCESSFUL|ENDED PRIOR TO COMPLETION)$/ AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND time > now() - 14d AND time <= now() - 7d GROUP BY "task"

panels.title: Task duration (daily)
panels.description: Maximum duration per day, all runs. PSM, AUTOBACKUP, AUTODUMP - start / end messages have no time: measured from the first to the last volume message (exact=false).

targets.query: SELECT max("duration") FROM "MF.HSM.DURATION" WHERE "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "task", "host_id" fill(none) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

panels.title: PSM - duration and volumes
panels.description: Primary Space Management: duration (left axis) and processed volumes (right axis). Approximate - from the first to the last ARC0522I.

targets.query: SELECT max("duration") AS "duration" FROM "MF.HSM.DURATION" WHERE "task" = 'PSM' AND "status" !~ /^(TERMINATED|FAILED|UNSUCCESSFUL|ENDED PRIOR TO COMPLETION)$/ AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "host_id" fill(none) tz('Europe/Warsaw')
SELECT sum("volumes") FROM "MF.HSM.DURATION" WHERE "task" = 'PSM' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "host_id" fill(none) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

panels.title: Automatic backup - duration and volumes
panels.description: Duration (left axis) and backed up volumes (right axis).

targets.query: SELECT max("duration") AS "duration" FROM "MF.HSM.DURATION" WHERE "task" = 'AUTOBACKUP' AND "status" !~ /^(TERMINATED|FAILED|UNSUCCESSFUL|ENDED PRIOR TO COMPLETION)$/ AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "host_id" fill(none) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

SELECT sum("volumes") FROM "MF.HSM.DURATION" WHERE "task" = 'AUTOBACKUP' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "host_id" fill(none) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

panels.title: Automatic dump - duration and volumes
panels.description: Duration (left axis) and dumped volumes (right axis).

targets.query: SELECT max("duration") AS "duration" FROM "MF.HSM.DURATION" WHERE "task" = 'AUTODUMP' AND "status" !~ /^(TERMINATED|FAILED|UNSUCCESSFUL|ENDED PRIOR TO COMPLETION)$/ AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "host_id" fill(none) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

SELECT sum("volumes") FROM "MF.HSM.DURATION" WHERE "task" = 'AUTODUMP' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "host_id" fill(none) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

panels.title: CDS backup - duration
panels.description: Backup of MCDS, BCDS, OCDS and journal: duration (left axis) and number of CDS data sets backed up (right axis).

targets.query: SELECT max("duration") AS "duration" FROM "MF.HSM.DURATION" WHERE "task" = 'CDSBACKUP' AND "status" !~ /^(TERMINATED|FAILED|UNSUCCESSFUL|ENDED PRIOR TO COMPLETION)$/ AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "host_id" fill(none) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

SELECT sum("datasets") FROM "MF.HSM.DURATION" WHERE "task" = 'CDSBACKUP' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "host_id" fill(none) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

panels.title: EXPIREBV - duration and expired versions
panels.description: Duration (left axis) and number of expired backup versions (right axis).

targets.query: SELECT max("duration") AS "duration" FROM "MF.HSM.DURATION" WHERE "task" = 'EXPIREBV' AND "status" !~ /^(TERMINATED|FAILED|UNSUCCESSFUL|ENDED PRIOR TO COMPLETION)$/ AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "host_id" fill(none) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

SELECT sum("versions") FROM "MF.HSM.DURATION" WHERE "task" = 'EXPIREBV' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "host_id" fill(none) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

panels.title: Fast Replication - duration per copy pool
panels.description: FRBACKUP: ARC1801I -> ARC1802I (logical completion, without background copy), successful runs

targets.query: SELECT max("duration") FROM "MF.HSM.DURATION" WHERE "task" = 'FRBACKUP' AND "status" !~ /^(TERMINATED|FAILED|UNSUCCESSFUL|ENDED PRIOR TO COMPLETION)$/ AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "copy_pool", "fr_function" fill(none) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

panels.title: Volumes processed per task (daily)
panels.description: Field volumes in MF.HSM.DURATION: PSM (ARC0523I), AUTOBACKUP (ARC0723I), AUTODUMP (ARC0623I), FRBACKUP (ARC1805I)

targets.query: SELECT sum("volumes") FROM "MF.HSM.DURATION" WHERE "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "task" fill(none) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

panels.title: Failed volumes per task (daily)
panels.description: Field volumes_failed: ARC0570I, ARC0623I ERRORS OCCURRED / FAILED, ARC1803E, ARC1818I

targets.query: SELECT sum("volumes_failed") FROM "MF.HSM.DURATION" WHERE "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "task" fill(0) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

panels.title: Data sets processed per task (daily)
panels.description: Field datasets: PSM - migrated / deleted (ARC0523I), AUTOBACKUP - backed up (ARC0723I)

targets.query: SELECT sum("datasets") FROM "MF.HSM.DURATION" WHERE "task" =~ /^(PSM|AUTOBACKUP)$/ AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "task" fill(none) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

panels.title: Volume backup - data sets per day
panels.description: ARC0723I: sum of DATA SETS BACKED UP per day

targets.query: SELECT sum("ds_backed_up") FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC0723I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "host_id" fill(0) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

panels.title: CDS backup - latest runs
panels.description: ARC0741I: result of the whole CDS backup

targets.query: SELECT "status", "kind", "host_id", "events" FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC0741I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: CDS / journal utilization [%]
panels.description: ARC0909E (SETSYS MONITOR threshold); lines at 80% and 90%

targets.query: SELECT max("percent") FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC0909E' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "dsid" fill(none)

panels.title: EXPIREBV - expired versions per day
panels.description: ARC0681I: NUMBER OF VERSIONS EXPIRED

targets.query: SELECT sum("versions_expired") FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC0681I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "host_id" fill(0) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

panels.title: Space freed per day
panels.description: ARC0523I: TRACK(S) FREED converted to bytes (56,664 bytes per 3390 track)

targets.query: SELECT sum("freed_bytes") FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC0523I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "host_id" fill(0) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

panels.title: Data sets migrated / deleted per day
panels.description: ARC0523I: DATA SET(S) MIGRATED/DELETED

targets.query: SELECT sum("ds_count") FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC0523I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "host_id" fill(0) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

panels.title: Volume dumps by result per day
panels.description: ARC0623I: PROCESSING SUCCESSFUL / ERRORS OCCURRED / FAILED

targets.query: SELECT sum("events") FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC0623I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "result" fill(0) tz('Europe/Warsaw')

panels.title: Fast Replication - latest
panels.description: ARC1802I: FUNCTION RC and MAXIMUM VOLUME RC per copy pool

targets.query: SELECT "copy_pool", "fr_function", "host_id", "function_rc", "max_volume_rc", "partialok" FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC1802I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Latest errors, interruptions and RC > 0
panels.description: Messages ...E, interrupted functions and all events with rc > 0 (e.g. ARC1001I)

targets.query: SELECT "msg_id", "host_id", "function", "operation", "volser", "dsid", "copy_pool", "rc", "reason" FROM "MF.HSM.EVENT" WHERE ("msg_id" =~ /E$/ OR "rc" > 0 OR "msg_id" =~ /^ARC(0570|0682|0625|1818|1837)I$/) AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Functions held
panels.description: QUERY ACTIVE snapshots: red = HELD

targets.query: SELECT last("recycle_held") FROM "MF.HSM.QUERY" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC0144I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host_id" fill(previous)
SELECT last("audit_held") FROM "MF.HSM.QUERY" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC0144I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host_id" fill(previous)

SELECT last("expirebv_held") FROM "MF.HSM.QUERY" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC0415I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host_id" fill(previous)

SELECT last("frbackup_held") FROM "MF.HSM.QUERY" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC1826I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host_id" fill(previous)

panels.title: Functions active
panels.description: QUERY ACTIVE snapshots: blue = ACTIVE

targets.query: SELECT last("volume_migration_active") FROM "MF.HSM.QUERY" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC0160I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host_id" fill(previous)

SELECT last("volume_backup_active") FROM "MF.HSM.QUERY" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC0163I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host_id" fill(previous)

SELECT last("volume_dump_active") FROM "MF.HSM.QUERY" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC0642I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host_id" fill(previous)

SELECT last("expirebv_active") FROM "MF.HSM.QUERY" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC0415I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host_id" fill(previous)

SELECT last("frbackup_active") FROM "MF.HSM.QUERY" WHERE "msg_id" = 'ARC1826I' AND "sysname" = '$sysname' AND "host_id" =~ /^$host_id$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host_id" fill(previous)
